profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, AI at Roku Inc.
profile.summary:
- AI expert with over 10 years of experience in applied research and development
- Successful track record of designing and implementing advanced AI/ML/NLP solutions for many industry challenges
- Strong engineering and research skills
- Proficient at leading and managing cross-functional projects

Specialties: Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Artificial Intelligence, Knowledge Graph, Knowledge Representation and Reasoning, Ontology Engineering, Information Extraction

Please visit https://sites.google.com/site/2soonk/ for more detail.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI
positions.description: Responsible for developing AI/ML solutions for Roku products

positions.title: Senior Research Engineer
positions.description:
Conduct conversational AI projects to productize the AI/NLP technologies for Adobe products

 * Design and develop various types of question answering (QA)/ search engines for the Adobe use cases (e.g., help service for Adobe products and document question answering). I was responsible for developing various types of QA technologies such as search-based QA, knowledge-based QA and video QA.

 * Design and develop NLP deep learning solutions (particularly, conversational AI technologies) for assistant services for Adobe products. I was a key member for developing the full-stack dialog engine such as Natural Language Understanding (NLU), Dialog-state Tracking (DST) and Dialog Manager (DM).

 * Lead large-scale data collection efforts. To enable the deep learning models for QA and Dialog systems, I designed and implemented multiple data collection frameworks using various platforms such as AMT and Upwork.

 * Design and build ontology/knowledge graph to support knowledge-based QA and dialog. I used various knowledge acquisition methods (e.g., manual knowledge engineering, automated information extraction, crowdsourcing, etc.) to build the knowledge bases for our QA/Dialog tasks.

 * Collaborate with product teams to productize the AI/ML research prototypes 

Lead other AI/NLP projects such as cross-lingual NLP, document summarization, multimodal understanding and language generation.

 * Develop and implement various deep learning models for many industry challenges pertaining to NLP. Many of them are novel, being  led as a patent or published in top-tier academic conferences.

positions.title: Senior Research Engineer
positions.description: Conducted the projects of constructing a large-scale knowledge graph (KG) from semi- and unstructured texts to enable intelligent services such as question answering and personal assistance. The targeted information sources were online and oine texts such as product manuals, how-to documents and POI information. I was responsible for the entire KG construction cycle such as (a) designing a schema/ontology (b) extracting information from texts and (c) normalizing the extracted information according to the schema/ontology and (d) developing natural language question answering service over the KB.

company.name: Robert Bosch Engineering and Business Solutions Ltd.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description: Developed and conducted a research program that includes identifying key business problems pertaining to unstructured data. In particular, we developed various patent-pending methods based on unsupervised and semi-supervised machine learning algorithms to quickly build information extraction rules and dictionaries. We also showed that our methods can produce high quality rules and dictionaries with little human supervision [EMNLP 2012][AAAI 2013]. Our methods are currently being piloted at various client projects to reduce the cost of analyzing unstructured data.

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description:
Developed a text understanding system that reads texts, converts the texts into machine understandable format, and answers questions. Through this project, we developed a method in which the system delays ambiguity resolution until it acquires more knowledge to confidently interpret the text. We also showed that our approach can significantly improve the quality of text interpretation [CoLing 2010]

Developed end-to-end Learning-by-Reading systems, M{\" o}bius and its descendant Kleo, that build knowledge bases by extracting information from texts. By developing them successfully with off-the-shelf components, we showed current NLP and KR technologies are mature enough to address the challenge of deep machine reading [AAAI 2007]. We particularly focused on addressing a problem of combining knowledge gleaned from text snippets to build a single coherent knowledge base. We showed that our approach can significantly improve the coherence of the resulting knowledge base [KCAP 2009]

Participated in the Halo Project whose long term goal was developing a reasoning system capable of answering novel questions for a broad range of domains (http://www.projecthalo.com). In this project, we developed a system in which domain experts (such as scientists or engineers) can build their own knowledge base rapidly. The system can also perform high-level reasoning to answer questions from na{\" i}ve users who have no knowledge of the internal structure of the knowledge base.

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Worked for the Deep Reading team developing a large-scale machine reading system. In particular, we explored various ways of exploiting IBM's large-scale knowledge base, Prismatic, in machine reading.

projects.title: Learning by Reading - Project Mobius
projects.description: Project Mobius was a DARPA funded feasibility study of Learning by Reading - i.e. the automated enhancement of knowledge bases through the analysis of texts. Mobius led to the approval of the DARPA Machine Reading program.
